objectives: 本課程目的在於建立博士班學生的個體經濟理論基礎。前半段主題為消費者理論，內容包括偏好、消費者的選擇、古典需求理論以及總合需求等。後半段探討生產理論與不確定情況下的選擇問題。
content:
“1 ( / ) Introduction
2 ( / ) Preference Relations and Choice Rules
3 ( / ) The Consumption Set and Competitive Budgets
4 ( / ) The Weak Axiom of Revealed Preference
5 ( / ) Preference and Utility
6 ( / ) The Utility Maximization Problem
7 ( / ) The Expenditure Minimization Problem
8 ( / ) Welfare Evaluation of Economic Changes
9 ( / ) Midterm Exam
10 ( / ) Production Sets
11 ( / ) The Profit Maximization Problem
12 ( / ) The Cost Minimization Problem
13 ( / ) Efficient Production
14 ( / ) Expected Utility Theory
15 ( / ) Money Lotteries and Risk Aversion
16 ( / ) Comparison of Payoff Distributions in terms of Return and Risk
17 ( / ) Subjective Probability Theory
18 ( / ) Final Exam“
books:
“Course Material
(課程教材) Mas-Colell, A., M. D. Whinston and J. R. Green, “Microeconomics Theory,” Oxford University Press, 1995.
Other Material
(其他參考書目) Varian, Hal R. “Microeconomic Analysis,” 3-rd ed., W. W. Norton ＆ Company, Inc., 1992“
grading_policy: 期中與期末考試各占百分之50。

distribution_conditions.rule: 系所:限經濟學系碩士班、經濟學系博士班。
